title: Unpack
purpose: Return a packed shipment to draft to change its contents or declarations.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, while the shipment is packed. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the timeline and history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The shipment becomes a draft again; the stored specimen versions, packer and checker are cleared. Its specimens stay picked and in it.
If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
